threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You know you're new if you still call it a 'night out' instead of a 'night in' at a pub that's actually a cafe.
Last night on the 59, a guy serenaded the whole bus with Elvis songs. Only in Brixton can a late-night ride feel like a mini concert.

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: I knew I was home when I saw a guy selling homemade jam out of a crate on Karl-Marx-Strasse, chatting with folks like they were old friends.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Berlin do you have spontaneous parties in the U-Bahn after a big soccer match. You might find a full-on rave between Warschauer Straße and Schönhauser Allee.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s a local if they can name all the taco trucks but still complain about the endless Muni delays from 'that dog on the tracks.'

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Caught the Muni today just after the dog incident at Civic Center. The driver joked it was the first pup to hold up the route this week.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia is just Gaudí and hipster bars, but the real charm is in the little squares where old folks play dominoes and share gossip.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell by their fascination with every single street performer in Plaça del Sol while locals just walk past without a glance.

threadTitle: Things that instantly reveal you just moved here
body: You still think the 67 bus comes on time, don't you? It's more of a guideline than a schedule around here.
Caught a guy on the 196 last night belting out old grime tracks. Whole bus was vibing like it was a live show. Only in Brixton, right?

threadTitle: When you knew you were actually living here
body: The moment I spotted a group of kids turning a bus stop into a stage, performing a full show during the BVG strike—only in Neukölln.

threadTitle: Things Berlin does that nowhere else does
body: Only in Kreuzberg do you find folks lining up for vegan currywurst at 3 AM, while the rest of the city winds down. It’s a late-night food pilgrimage.

threadTitle: Real signs someone is from here vs just working here
body: You know someone’s from here if they actually know the difference between El Techo and its rooftop view versus the waiting line at La Taqueria.

threadTitle: Muni moments that define this city
body: Just saw a Muni driver hop out to chase down a stray dog on the tracks. Classic SF moment—only here do you find heart and chaos colliding.

threadTitle: Things tourists get wrong about living here
body: Tourists think Gràcia's plazas are just for selfies, but locals know they’re the heartbeats of neighborhood life, especially during the evenings.

threadTitle: How to spot a recent arrival
body: You can tell a recent arrival by their hesitation at the crosswalk—waiting for the green light even when it’s clear. Locals just walk.
